author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Huntress webhooks for incident reports, escalations, platform actions and account notices. Huntress posts them to bridges/webhook-relay in this repo, which checks the Svix signature and forwards each body to HTTP Ingest. Incident report and escalation events go to the third-party alert schema, and platform action and account notice events stay generic.
notes:
Setup:
- Huntress has no syslog export; its webhooks (Integrations > Add an Integration > Webhooks) post JSON for incident reports, escalations, platform actions and account notices.
- An endpoint takes only a URL and the categories, and HTTP Ingest needs an Authorization: Bearer header, so point the endpoint at bridges/webhook-relay in this repo, which checks the Svix signature Huntress sends and forwards the body to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration with the bearer token.

Field mapping:
- Incident report and escalation events (created, closed, comment added, overdue) go to the third-party alert schema; platform action and account notice events stay generic.

Time:
- The engine replaces an event time in the future with the ingest time.

Sources and licenses:
- Fields follow Huntress's public webhook payload reference.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the reference's schemas.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (91 of 91 fields matched the emulator).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.

Known gaps:
- The payload has no host name, only agent_id, so look the agent up with the Huntress API when you need it.
